name: Harvest
label: Harvest API v2
description: Harvest API v2 at https://api.harvestapp.com/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://help.getharvest.com/api-v2/. Bearer access_token + Harvest-Account-Id. Never log tokens or PII.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Harvest official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"client_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'client_create', 'client_get', 'client_list', 'client_update', 'client_delete', 'contact_create', 'contact_get', 'contact_list', 'contact_update', 'contact_delete', 'company_get', 'estimate_create', 'estimate_get', 'estimate_list', 'estimate_update', 'estimate_delete', 'expense_create', 'expense_get', 'expense_list', 'expense_update', 'expense_delete', 'invoice_create', 'invoice_get', 'invoice_list', 'invoice_update', 'invoice_delete', 'project_create', 'project_get', 'project_list', 'project_update', 'project_delete', 'task_create', 'task_get', 'task_list', 'task_update', 'task_delete', 'time_entry_create_duration', 'time_entry_create_start_end', 'time_entry_get', 'time_entry_list', 'time_entry_update', 'time_entry_delete', 'time_entry_restart', 'time_entry_stop', 'user_create', 'user_get', 'user_list', 'user_update', 'user_delete', 'user_me'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'client_create'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: client_create, client_get, client_list, client_update, client_delete, contact_create, contact_get, contact_list, contact_update, contact_delete, company_get, estimate_create, estimate_get, estimate_list, estimate_update, estimate_delete, expense_create, expense_get, expense_list, expense_update, expense_delete, invoice_create, invoice_get, invoice_list, invoice_update, invoice_delete, project_create, project_get, project_list, project_update, project_delete, task_create, task_get, task_list, task_update, task_delete, time_entry_create_duration, time_entry_create_start_end, time_entry_get, time_entry_list, time_entry_update, time_entry_delete, time_entry_restart, time_entry_stop, user_create, user_get, user_list, user_update, user_delete, user_me. Default: client_create. Example: client_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Account Id
configurationParameters.description: Harvest account id sent as Harvest-Account-Id (required by Harvest API v2). Example: '123456'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
